Advanced AI Solutions We Develop at Q2M

Apart from the traditional AI development services, Q2M has a reputation for designing cutting-edge AI solutions that span the technology stack. Go a step further from traditional automation with our intelligent solutions that independently interpret the context, learn from the data, and adapt to the shifting business needs. Foster innovation and measurable ROI with our advanced AI development services:

Agentic AI Systems To replace repetitive tasks that demand manual effort, we build autonomous AI agents for independent planning, understanding, and action to complete tasks. These self-operated systems use multi-step workflows that eliminate the need for human intervention. These systems empower automation to make real-time decisions and adapt to the changing conditions for simplified business operations.

Computer Vision Solutions Our AI experts design AI development services that analyse and interpret data from virtual content such as images and videos. These AI systems assist with object detection, facial recognition, security enhancement, and quality analysis. This category of AI solutions is highly valuable in manufacturing, healthcare, and retail sectors to foster automated inspection, intelligent monitoring, and real-time analysis.

Natural Language Processing (NLP) The NLP systems help to understand, interpret, and generate human language for automating business processes and extracting valuable insights from unstructured data. These solutions help with sentiment analysis, language translation, text classification, and document summarisation.

Generative AI Development As a custom AI development company, Q2M builds generative AI solutions for customising content, code, design, and recommendations. Our image generators, hybrid systems, and language models ensure human-quality output that complies with the marketing, product design, and operational workflow of your business.

Predictive Analytics and Machine Learning Our predictive AI models forecast future trends, user behaviour, market demand, and operational risks based on historical user data. The AI/ML models designed by our team of AI engineers help reduce churn rate and optimise inventory to facilitate data-driven decision-making, revenue growth, and operational efficiency.

Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) Machine Learning Operations is one of our advanced AI development services that streamlines your AI development lifecycle, from model development to deployment and monitoring. It fosters reliability, performance, and scalability, all with reduced manual efforts. The workflow automation and constant optimisation ensure that the AI/ML models stay secure, up to date, and accurate.

Recommendation Systems For tailoring the user experience across online portals and e-commerce platforms, we develop intelligent recommendation engines. Using customer data and machine learning, we provide targeted product suggestions, recommendations, and dynamic pricing to enhance user engagement and drive sales.

Deep Learning Solutions The deep learning expertise of our AI engineers offers advanced AI models that simplify complex pattern recognition and decision-making. These are neural network-based AI solutions that handle high-value data from supply chain optimisation, risk assessments, and fraud detection to deliver valuable insights beyond traditional analytics.

Conversational AI The chatbots or virtual assistants that you see on almost every website are the impact of conversational AI. We design AI-powered conversational AI solutions that replicate human-like communication for more intelligent engagement and round-the-clock assistance. No need to multiply your staff headcount when our AI development services can handle it all.

AI-Enabled IoT Our AI integration into Internet of Things (IoT) devices facilitates smart, autonomous, and automated operations. These solutions process data in real-time by identifying defects, predicting failures, and automating responses that translate raw data into actionable outputs.

Edge AI Our AI solutions are directly deployed on edge devices for faster, real-time decision-making without the dependency on cloud computing. Our Edge AI solutions render fast responses with reduced latency by locally processing data, minimising costs, and protecting sensitive information.

FAQ

faqs.q: What's the difference between generic and custom AI development services?
a: Generic AI solutions are off-the-shelf and pre-built, which is why they are not industry- specific. They are designed for broad use cases, but there is a lack of flexibility.

Custom AI development services are built from scratch to align with your business needs, challenges, and industry standards. As compared to generic AI services, custom AI services are difficult to implement but deliver long-term business value.

faqs.q: What is the development timeline for an AI solution?
a: The timeline for AI development services varies based on several factors, such as project scope and complexity, business goals, project budget, level of integration and features needed, team size and resources, testing and validation, data availability, etc. To find out the exact timeline for custom AI development with Q2M, connect with our experts today.

faqs.q: How much does it cost to build custom AI solutions?
a: Custom AI development can range anywhere from $5000 to $500,000+ based on key factors, such as integration requirement, data readiness, infrastructure and data system architecture, team size and location, project scope and complexity, project timeline, etc.

faqs.q: How do you ensure data security and privacy as an AI development company?
a: As a reputed and responsible AI development company, our experts at Q2M implement industry-rated techniques throughout the development lifecycle. We adhere to stringent data privacy regulations, such as data encryption, restricted access controls, two-factor authentication, regular audits, and so on.

faqs.q: How do you ensure seamless integration of AI into existing systems?
a: At Q2M, our team of AI experts follows a structured development approach to ensure smooth integration of AI solutions into existing systems without disrupting operations. Our process includes:
• Discovery and Insights • Data Collection and Processing • AI Model Development and Innovation • Training and Optimisation • Seamless Integration • Constant Monitoring and Support

faqs.q: What to look for when choosing a custom AI development company like Q2M?
a: When you are choosing to partner with a custom AI development company like Q2M, here are a few hygiene checks that you can’t miss:
• Industry expertise • Strong technical competence • Successful client portfolio • An in-house team of AI specialists • Client reviews and testimonials • Dynamic pricing model

faqs.q: Do you offer support after the AI solution is deployed?
a: Yes, we believe in fostering a long-term development partnership, which is why we provide end-to-end assistance. This includes constant monitoring, updates, and maintenance post-deployment to ensure the AI solutions deliver results and comply with industry regulations.
